# ionic-design-system

> Typed, accessible React component library with design system theming via CSS stylesheets.

## Installation

```bash
npm install ionic-design-system
```

Peer dependencies: react (>=18), react-dom (>=18), lucide-react (optional, for Icon component).

## Stylesheet Setup

Link the design system CSS in your app entry point. The CSS file is exported from
the design editor and provides all token values and component variant styles.

```tsx
import './your-design-system.css'; // exported from the Ionic Design System editor
import { Button, Text, Container } from 'ionic-design-system';
```

Without a stylesheet, components render with built-in fallback styles.

## Variant System

Most components accept flat variant props AND/OR a `dimensionValues` object.
Flat props are sugar -- both are equivalent:

```tsx
<Button size="md" color="primary" />
<Button dimensionValues={{ size: 'md', color: 'primary' }} />
```

Variant values map to `data-*` attributes on the DOM node, which the CSS
stylesheet targets. Invalid variant values are silently ignored.

---

## Components

### Button
Interactive button with optional icon. Extends `<button>` HTML attributes.
Props: label (string), icon (string, registry name e.g. "Plus"), iconPosition ("left"|"right"), iconOnly (boolean), interactions (Interaction[]), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), intent ("primary"|"secondary"|"danger"|"success"|"warning"|"info"|"neutral"), appearance ("solid"|"soft"|"outline"|"ghost"), shape ("rounded"|"pill"|"sharp")
Note: Use `intent` for color selection (not `color`). Appearance + intent combine: e.g., appearance="solid" intent="primary" gives a blue filled button.
Usage: `<Button label="Save" intent="primary" appearance="solid" size="md" />`

### Text
Text element with semantic tag control. Extends `<span>` HTML attributes.
Props: text (string), tag ("span"|"p"|"h1".."h6"|"label", default "span"), italic (boolean), underline (boolean), strikethrough (boolean), truncate (boolean), transform ("none"|"uppercase"|"lowercase"|"capitalize"), size ("xs"|"sm"|"base"|"lg"|"xl"|"2xl"|"3xl"), color ("default"|"muted"|"primary"|"success"|"destructive"), weight ("normal"|"medium"|"semibold"|"bold"), align ("left"|"center"|"right"|"justify")
Usage: `<Text text="Hello" tag="h1" size="2xl" weight="bold" />`

### Container
Layout wrapper supporting flex, grid, and block. Extends `<div>` HTML attributes.
Props: interactions (Interaction[]), color ("neutral"|"card"|"muted"|"primary"|"secondary"), padding ("none"|"sm"|"md"|"lg"), display ("flex"|"grid"|"block"), direction ("row"|"column"|"row-reverse"|"column-reverse"), alignment ("start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"space-between"), spacing ("none"|"sm"|"md"|"lg"), wrap ("wrap"|"nowrap"), columns ("1"|"2"|"3"|"4"), elevation ("none"|"sm"|"md"|"lg"), shape ("none"|"rounded"|"pill")
Usage: `<Container display="flex" direction="column" spacing="md" padding="lg">{children}</Container>`

### Input
Atomic `<input>` wrapper. Extends HTML input attributes (minus `size`/`color`).
Props: placeholder (string), value (string), onChange (handler), type (string, default "text"), disabled (boolean), size ("sm"|"default"|"lg"), color ("default"), align ("left"|"center"|"right"), elevation ("none"|"sm"|"md"), shape ("rounded"|"square"|"pill")
Usage: `<Input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" size="default" />`

### Textarea
Multi-line text input. Extends HTML textarea attributes (minus `color`).
Props: placeholder (string), rows (number, default 3), resize ("none"|"both"|"horizontal"|"vertical", default "both"), disabled (boolean), readOnly (boolean), name (string), size ("sm"|"default"|"lg"), color ("default")
Usage: `<Textarea placeholder="Write a message..." rows={4} />`

### Select
Native `<select>` wrapper with optional label/caption. Extends HTML select attributes (minus `size`).
Props: placeholder (string), label (string), caption (string), options (Array<{value,label}> | string[] | comma-separated string), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), color ("default"|"primary"|"muted"), appearance ("outline"|"filled"|"ghost"), shape ("rounded"|"sharp"|"pill"), state ("default"|"invalid"|"required")
Usage: `<Select label="Country" options={["US","UK","CA"]} size="md" />`

### Checkbox
Checkbox with visual indicator. Extends HTML input attributes (minus `size`/`color`).
Props: checked (boolean), defaultChecked (boolean), onChange (handler), disabled (boolean), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), color ("default"), border ("none"|"pill"|"sharp"|"rounded"), label ("none"|"right")
Usage: `<Checkbox checked={agreed} onChange={handler} size="md" />`

### Radio
Radio button (visual circle + hidden input). Extends HTML input attributes (minus `size`/`type`/`color`).
Props: checked (boolean), onChange (handler), disabled (boolean), name (string, for grouping), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), color ("default"|"primary"|"neutral")
Usage: `<Radio name="plan" value="pro" checked={plan === 'pro'} onChange={handler} />`

### Switch
Toggle switch (role="switch"). Extends HTML input attributes (minus `size`/`type`/`color`).
Props: checked (boolean), defaultChecked (boolean), onChange (handler), disabled (boolean), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), color ("primary"|"success"|"danger"|"warning"|"info"|"neutral")
Usage: `<Switch checked={darkMode} onChange={handler} color="primary" />`

### Slider
Range slider supporting single and range modes. Extends `<div>` attributes.
Props: value (number | [number,number]), defaultValue (number | [number,number]), min (number), max (number), step (number), disabled (boolean), onChange ((value) => void), mode ("single"|"range"), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), color ("primary"|"success"|"warning"|"danger"|"info"|"neutral"), orientation ("horizontal"|"vertical")
Usage: `<Slider value={50} min={0} max={100} onChange={setVal} />`

### Badge
Small label for status/counts. Extends `<span>` HTML attributes.
Props: label (string), interactions (Interaction[]), color ("default"|"primary"|"success"|"warning"|"danger"|"info"|"muted"), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), shape ("rounded"|"pill"|"sharp")
Usage: `<Badge label="New" color="success" size="sm" />`

### Alert
Notification banner with title, description, icon, and dismiss.
Props: title (string), description (string), icon (string), dismissible (boolean, default false), intent ("info"|...), appearance ("soft"|...), shape ("rounded"|...)
Usage: `<Alert title="Success" description="Your changes were saved." intent="info" />`

### Avatar
User avatar with image, initials, or status badge.
Props: src (string), alt (string), initials (string), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"|"xl"), color ("default"|"primary"|"neutral"), shape ("circle"|"rounded"|"sharp"), content ("initials"|"image"), badge ("none"|"online"|"offline"|"busy"), group ("none"|"group"|"count")
Usage: `<Avatar src="/photo.jpg" alt="Jane" size="lg" shape="circle" />`

### Label
Form label with optional required indicator.
Props: text (string), required (boolean, default false), htmlFor (string), size (string)
Usage: `<Label text="Email" htmlFor="email-input" required />`

### Link
Anchor element with text styling. Extends `<a>` HTML attributes (minus `color`).
Props: text (string), label (string), href (string, required), underline (boolean), italic (boolean), transform ("none"|"uppercase"|"lowercase"|"capitalize"), interactions (Interaction[]), size ("sm"|"default"|"lg"), color ("default"|"muted"|"foreground"), weight ("normal"|"medium"|"semibold"|"bold")
Usage: `<Link href="/docs" text="Documentation" color="default" />`

### Icon
SVG icon from built-in Lucide registry.
Props: name (string, default "Circle"), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), color ("inherit"|"primary"|"muted"), state ("show"|"hide")
Usage: `<Icon name="Settings" size="md" color="primary" />`

### Image
`<img>` wrapper with fit/aspect-ratio variants. Extends HTML img attributes.
Props: src (string), alt (string), fit ("cover"|"contain"|"fill"|"none"|"scale-down"), aspectRatio ("auto"|"1/1"|"3/2"|"4/3"|"16/9"|"9/16"|"2/1")
Usage: `<Image src="/hero.jpg" alt="Hero" fit="cover" aspectRatio="16/9" />`

### Divider
Horizontal or vertical separator. Extends `<hr>` HTML attributes.
Props: orientation ("horizontal"|"vertical", default "horizontal"), size ("thin"|"medium"|"thick"), color ("default"|"muted"|"primary")
Usage: `<Divider orientation="horizontal" color="muted" />`

### Spinner
Loading indicator with CSS animation.
Props: variant ("circular"|"dots"|"bars", default "circular"), label (string, default "Loading"), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), color ("primary"|"secondary"|"success"|"warning"|"danger"|"info"|"neutral"|"white")
Usage: `<Spinner size="md" color="primary" />`

### Progress
Progress bar (determinate or indeterminate). ARIA role="progressbar".
Props: value (number, 0-100), max (number, default 100), indeterminate (boolean, default false), size ("sm"|"default"|"lg"), color ("default"|"success"|"warning"|"danger")
Usage: `<Progress value={65} color="success" />`

### Skeleton
Loading placeholder with animation.
Props: shape ("rectangle"|"circle"|"text"), animation ("pulse"|"wave"|"none"), width (string), height (string)
Usage: `<Skeleton shape="text" animation="pulse" width="200px" height="16px" />`

### Toast
Notification popup with auto-dismiss. Position is viewport-fixed.
Props: title (string), description (string), duration (number, ms; 0 = no auto-dismiss), dismissible (boolean), onClose (() => void), variant ("default"|"success"|"error"|"warning"|"info"), position ("top-right"|"top-left"|"bottom-right"|"bottom-left"|"top-center"|"bottom-center")
Usage: `<Toast title="Saved" variant="success" position="bottom-right" duration={3000} />`

### Tooltip (primitive)
Contextual hint, shown/hidden via interaction system.
Props: content (string), arrow (boolean), interactions (Interaction[]), color ("dark"|"light"), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg")
Usage: See Compositions > TooltipRoot for the recommended compound API.

### Tab
Tab button with selected/unselected states.
Props: label (string), icon (string), selected (boolean), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), appearance ("contained"|"pills"|"line"), color ("default"|"primary"|"neutral"), orientation ("horizontal"|"vertical")
Usage: `<Tab label="Overview" selected={activeTab === 0} onClick={() => setTab(0)} />`

### ToggleButton
Button with pressed/unpressed toggle state.
Props: pressed (boolean), onPressedChange ((pressed: boolean) => void), label (string), icon (string), iconPosition ("left"|"right"), iconOnly (boolean), size ("sm"|"md"|"lg"), appearance ("outline"|"ghost")
Usage: `<ToggleButton label="Bold" icon="Bold" pressed={isBold} onPressedChange={setIsBold} />`

### MenuItem
Menu item row with icon, label, shortcut, and disabled state.
Props: label (string), icon (string), shortcut (string), disabled (boolean), size ("sm"|"md"), color ("default"|"danger")
Usage: `<MenuItem label="Delete" icon="Trash2" shortcut="Del" color="danger" />`

### Table
HTML table with sub-components: TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption.
Props (Table): variant (string), size (string). Sub-components are thin forwardRef wrappers.
Usage:
```tsx
<Table>
  <TableHeader><TableRow><TableHead>Name</TableHead></TableRow></TableHeader>
  <TableBody><TableRow><TableCell>Alice</TableCell></TableRow></TableBody>
</Table>
```

---

## Compositions (Compound Components)

All compositions follow the Root/Trigger/Content pattern. Trigger uses `asChild`
by default (renders your child element directly, no extra wrapper).

### TooltipRoot / TooltipTrigger / TooltipContent
Hover-triggered positioned tooltip. No InteractionProvider needed.
Props (Root): open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, showDelay (number, default 0), hideDelay (number, default 0)
Props (Content): placement (Placement), offset (number), children
```tsx
<TooltipRoot>
  <TooltipTrigger><Button label="Hover me" /></TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent placement="top" offset={8}>Helpful tip</TooltipContent>
</TooltipRoot>
```

### PopoverRoot / PopoverTrigger / PopoverContent
Click-triggered positioned content. Dismisses on click-outside and Escape.
Props (Root): open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, dismissOnClickOutside (default true), dismissOnEscape (default true)
Props (Content): placement (Placement), offset (number), children
```tsx
<PopoverRoot>
  <PopoverTrigger><Button label="Options" /></PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent placement="bottom-start"><MenuItem label="Edit" /></PopoverContent>
</PopoverRoot>
```

### DialogRoot / DialogTrigger / DialogOverlay / DialogContent / DialogClose
Modal dialog with overlay, focus trap, and focus restore.
Props (Root): open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, dismissOnEscape (default true)
```tsx
<DialogRoot>
  <DialogTrigger><Button label="Open" /></DialogTrigger>
  <DialogOverlay />
  <DialogContent>
    <Text tag="h2" text="Confirm" />
    <DialogClose><Button label="Close" /></DialogClose>
  </DialogContent>
</DialogRoot>
```

### DisclosureRoot / DisclosureTrigger / DisclosureContent
Click-to-toggle inline collapsible. No positioning or portal.
Props (Root): open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange
```tsx
<DisclosureRoot>
  <DisclosureTrigger><Button label="Show Details" /></DisclosureTrigger>
  <DisclosureContent><Text text="Expanded content" /></DisclosureContent>
</DisclosureRoot>
```

### AccordionRoot / AccordionItem / AccordionTrigger / AccordionContent
Expandable sections. Supports single or multiple open items.
Props (Root): type ("single"|"multiple"), value, defaultValue, onValueChange
Props (Item): value (string, required), disabled (boolean)
```tsx
<AccordionRoot type="single" defaultValue="item-1">
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section 1</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content 1</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</AccordionRoot>
```

### DropdownMenuRoot / DropdownMenuTrigger / DropdownMenuContent / DropdownMenuItem / DropdownMenuSeparator
Click-triggered dropdown with keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home, End).
Props (Root): open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange
Props (Content): placement (Placement), offset (number)
Props (Item): onSelect (() => void), disabled (boolean)
```tsx
<DropdownMenuRoot>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger><Button label="Actions" /></DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => edit()}>Edit</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => del()} disabled>Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenuRoot>
```

---

## Interaction System

For imperative show/hide/toggle between any components, wrap them in
InteractionProvider and use `id` + `interactions` props:

```tsx
import { InteractionProvider, Button, Tooltip } from 'ionic-design-system';

<InteractionProvider>
  <Button
    id="btn-1"
    label="Hover me"
    interactions={[{ on: 'hover', action: 'show', target: 'tip-1' }]}
  />
  <Tooltip id="tip-1" hidden content="Extra info" />
</InteractionProvider>
```

Interaction objects: `{ on: 'click'|'hover'|'focus', action: 'show'|'hide'|'toggle', target: string }`
Components that support `interactions` prop: Button, Container, Badge, Tooltip, Link.
Target components use `id` + `hidden` to start invisible.

For most use cases, prefer Compositions (TooltipRoot, PopoverRoot, etc.) over
the imperative InteractionProvider pattern.

---

## Common Patterns

### Form layout
```tsx
<Container display="flex" direction="column" spacing="md" padding="lg">
  <Label text="Email" htmlFor="email" required />
  <Input id="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
  <Label text="Message" htmlFor="msg" />
  <Textarea id="msg" rows={4} />
  <Button label="Submit" color="primary" />
</Container>
```

### Card
```tsx
<Container color="card" padding="lg" elevation="md" shape="rounded">
  <Text tag="h3" text="Card Title" size="lg" weight="semibold" />
  <Text text="Card body text" color="muted" />
</Container>
```

### Navigation tabs
```tsx
<Container display="flex" direction="row" spacing="none">
  {tabs.map((t, i) => (
    <Tab key={i} label={t} selected={active === i} onClick={() => setActive(i)} appearance="line" />
  ))}
</Container>
```

---

## Do NOT

- Do NOT pass editor-only props: nodeId, canvasId, resolvedProps, stateStyles, previewState, enableInteractiveStates. These are internal to the design editor.
- Do NOT use `content` prop on Text (deprecated). Use `text` or children.
- Do NOT forget `name` on Radio groups -- radios without a shared `name` won't be mutually exclusive.
- Do NOT use the primitive Tooltip component for hover tooltips. Use the TooltipRoot composition instead.
- Do NOT set variant values that don't exist in the type union -- they will be silently ignored and produce no styling.
